pages.text: $(#8B0000)🔥 Infernal Pact · Ashen Rebirth 🍄$()$(br2)$(l)$(#FF4500)「Burning the viscera in exchange for crimson eyes that pierce the night and feet that shatter the earth」$()$(br)When the toxicity of $(#8B0000)Crimson Cap Mushroom$(), the fury of $(#FF4500)Netherfire Ash$(), the vitality of $(#006400)Emerald Veins$(), and the resilience of $(#8B0000)Scarlet Iron Veins$() are forcibly fused within the $(#483D8B)Obsidian Cauldron$()—this becomes an alchemical taboo capable of $(l)allowing mortals to touch the domain of demons$().

$(#8B0000)▌ Demonic Transaction $()$(br2)$(l)$(#4169E1)👁 Infernal Eyes$()$(br)Vision pierces through $(#000080)eternal darkness$(), revealing $(#8B0000)blood-red membranes$().$(br2)$(l)$(#FF4500)⚡ Lava Pulse$()$(br)Fists erupt with $(#CD5C5C)volcanic cracks$() upon impact.$(br2)$(l)$(#32CD32)🌪 Ash Sprint$()$(br)Movement leaves behind $(#7CFC00)glowing embers$().$(br2)$(#4B0082)☠ Poisonous Blood Price $()$(br)$(l)$(#006400)🍃 Viscera Wildfire$()$(br)Organs burn continuously, infused with $(#8B0000)crimson toxins$().

$(br2)$(#483D8B)▌ Abyssal Crafting $()$(br)- Crush $(#8B0000)Red Mushrooms$() in a $(#696969)Obsidian Mortar$() until they form $(#CD5C5C)a blood-like paste$().$(br)- $(#FF4500)Blaze Powder$() must be pre-melted with $(#006400)Green Tea$() under $(#8B0000)Dragon’s Breath Flame$().$(br)- When adding $(#8B0000)Black Tea$(), one must complete the $(#FF0000)Reverse Pentagram Stirring Pattern$().$(br2)$(#FFD700)※$() Stop heating immediately when the liquid displays $(#8B0000)dragon-scale patterns$() and emits $(#7CFC00)emerald toxic mist$().

$(br2)$(#8B0000)『 Burned Alchemy Notes 』$()$(br)A surviving fragment reads:$(br)'Those who consume this $(#CD5C5C)Demonic Blood Brew$(),$(br)shall gain:$(br)- $(#4169E1)The night vision of an Abyss Watcher$().$(br)- $(#FF4500)The destructive strength of an Infernal Titan$().$(br)- $(#32CD32)The extreme speed of a Wind Sprite$().$(br)However, $(#4B0082)every ounce of power$() must be repaid with $(#006400)burning organs$(),$(br)until $(#8B0000)Crimson Toxins$() transform the body into an $(#483D8B)Ash Puppet$().'
